author: lskull
quote: I put roughly 8 hours into GTA 6 before uninstalling and getting a refund. On a technical level, the world looks incredible, but Rockstar pushed the realism so far that they completely stripped the fun out of it.​I loved Red Dead Redemption 2, so I don't mind a slower game when the story and characters earn it. Here, the hyper-realism just turns GTA into a tedious chore simulator. Having to pull gear out of car trunks, set up bank accounts, move and fix furniture, and paint walls isn't fun—it's just busywork. Nobody playing as CJ or Trevor ever sat there thinking the game was missing DIY and life admin. Fixing up a house isn't what made GTA great; it's completely pointless.​The characters don't save it, either. Jason basically sounds like Arthur Morgan stripped of all the wit, charm, and depth. Playing as someone that boring just to run around trying to impress a character as annoying as Lucia killed any interest I had in the story.​Amazing graphics and tiny details don't mean much when the missions are a slog and you couldn't care less about the people you're playing as.
